blockers.where: modal f0 / f_max under a macro
blockers.wanted: a 'weight' knob that moves the body pitch down and keeps centroid falling monotonically
blockers.tried: macro mapping modal f0 only (plus filter cutoffs): verify claim centroid-falls FAILED (1.3k, 823, 515, 972, 779 Hz) because the second plate mode (2.5x f0) crossed a fixed f_max as f0 moved
blockers.workaround: mapped f_max together with f0 (f_max = 1.5 x f0) in the same macro

blockers.wanted: one clear answer to 'attack under 5 ms'
blockers.tried: listen gives 10-90 % rise 0.045 s (the body), swell/attack 0.8 ms (the click), onset table attack 1.0 ms for the click; they disagree for a click-then-body sound
blockers.workaround: used the swell/attack headline and the onset table

blockers.wanted: set the body level against the latch click
blockers.tried: contact mass 2.5 speed 2.5 (area 62): modal output is normalized per unit area so the body swamped the click by ~30 dB
blockers.workaround: speed 0.04 so area is 1, then gains in the mix; a level field on contact or modal would be clearer

wishlist: a level/gain_db field on contact or modal
a body that is not a near-pure sine for a thud (modal plate with f_max gives one or two modes; I added a brown-noise thump)
a verify check on the first N ms (attack under X ms) rather than reading three attack numbers
what_worked: click kind latch gave the latch transient and a 45 ms release snick in one node
contact -> modal with f0 and f_max placed the body at 66 Hz directly
verify macros sweep told me exactly which knob claim failed and the measured values
